textRuns.value: Punch is not quality control - it confirms readiness. Zero Punch is the stated objective. Items beyond 5 days escalate to the trade PM, beyond 7 to the trade executive, which is why ageing is a headline here. Open and overdue counts are as of today; a month selection groups them by creation month.
